name: Pnina Maluna Ferkel
original_name: プニーナ・マルナ・フェアケル
source:
Favorite food: Sweet food, fried food, meat... everything!
Hobbies: Dieting

[url=/c50478]Kisara's[/url] younger half-sister.

Her three sizes and weight vary depending on how much she eats and exercises. Eating a lot will cause her to get fat. (Ecchi activities also cause her 3 sizes and weight to vary).

Variant 1: Weight: 50kg Bust-Waist-Hips: 66-48-75cm (B Cup)

Variant 2: Weight: 59kg Bust-Waist-Hips: 90-48-81cm (K Cup)

Variant 3: Weight: 64kg Bust-Waist-Hips: 95-70-90cm (E Cup)
(Variant 3 is her default statistics.)
